list.title: Pages
list.description: Pages independent of posts, such as About, contact, and legal texts (privacy, terms, imprint). Pages never appear in post listings, feeds, or search.
list.loadError: Pages could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
list.cardDescription: Drafts are visible to editors and admins only.

newPage.title: New page
newPage.cardDescription: The page is saved as a draft and stays invisible to visitors until you publish it.

editPage.loadErrorDescription: The page is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
editPage.publishedDescription: Published since {publishedAt}. Pages have a single version: saved changes go live immediately.
editPage.draftDescription: This page is a draft. Once published it appears under /pages, in the sitemap, and in the footer if it is a legal page.
editPage.formCardDescription: Changes to a draft are not visible to visitors.
editPage.formCardPublishedDescription: This page is live; changes are visible as soon as you save.
editPage.unsupportedDescription: This page's content uses version {version} and cannot be opened in this editor.

form.title: Title
form.slugHelp: Leave empty to derive it from the title. If a published page's slug changes, the old address redirects to the new one.
form.kindHelp: Only one page of each legal type can be published. The privacy page is linked from the sign-up and comment forms.
form.metaDescriptionHelp: Optional, at most 300 characters. Shown in search results and share previews.
form.liveWarning: This page is live. Saving makes your changes visible to visitors immediately and updates its last-updated date.

publish.title: Publish this page?
publish.description: “{title}” will become public, be added to the sitemap, and be listed in the footer if it is a legal page.

unpublish.title: Unpublish this page?
unpublish.description: “{title}” will return 404 to visitors and disappear from menus, the footer, and the sitemap.

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.description: “{title}” will be deleted permanently. If a menu links it, remove it from the menu first.

validation.titleTooLong: The title can be at most 200 characters.
validation.slugMissing: No slug could be derived; add letters or digits to the title or enter a slug.
validation.slugTooLong: The slug can be at most 200 characters.
validation.slugInvalid: The slug may contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
validation.metaDescriptionTooLong: The description can be at most 300 characters.

actionErrors.noSession: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
actionErrors.formInvalid: Fix the errors in the form.
actionErrors.bodyUnsupported: The content could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
actionErrors.bodyInvalidField: The content contains an unsupported element.

errors.forbidden: Only editors and admins can manage pages.
errors.conflict: This page changed while you were editing it. Open the current version and apply your changes again.
errors.slug: This slug is already used by another page.
errors.kind: A published page of this type already exists. Unpublish it or change its type first.
errors.body: The content could not be validated.
errors.title: The title is invalid.
errors.metaDescription: The description can be at most 300 characters.
errors.state: The page is not in a state that allows this action.
errors.linked: A menu links this page. Remove it from the menu first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time. Try again later.
errors.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.

denied.title: No access to page management
denied.description: Only editors and admins can manage pages and menus.

navigation.title: Menus
navigation.intro: The header menu and footer links appear on every page. An item links a page or an external address starting with https; items that link a draft stay hidden until it is published.
navigation.loadError: Menus could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.

header.title: Header menu
header.description: Shown next to the site name.

footer.title: Footer links
footer.description: When empty, the published legal pages (privacy, terms, imprint, cookies) are listed automatically.

empty.header: The header menu has no items.
empty.footer: The footer has no items; published legal pages are shown automatically.

navigation.label: Label
navigation.labelOptional: Label (optional; defaults to the page title)
navigation.conflict: This menu changed while you were editing it. Open the current menu and apply your changes again.
navigation.tooMany: A menu can have at most 50 items.
navigation.saveFailed: The menu could not be saved. Check the links and try again.

errors.urlInvalid: The address must start with https:// and contain no spaces.
errors.labelTooLong: The label can be at most 80 characters.
